title: M0.3 Event ledger record (FROZEN @ phase-5, module-design.md §M0.3)
description: One record per kunglao-record ledger.jsonl line. event_id = sha256(event_type + canonical payload) is the idempotency key; checksum = sha256(canonical JSON of the whole record except checksum). ts is an additional field of this implementation (traceable ledger time), not required by the M0.3 dataclass.
